mainEntity.name: Do French doors require a permit for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether French door installation requires a permit depends on the scope of work and local building codes. Simple replacements where the new doors fit the existing opening without structural changes often do not require a permit. However, creating a new opening, enlarging an existing one, or any structural modifications typically do necessitate a permit. As a construction company serving Alameda, Albany, Berkeley, Dublin, and Emeryville, Hometelligent Inc. is familiar with local regulations and can advise you on permit requirements for your specific project during the initial assessment.
